subject.title: refactor: remove expired plugin compatibility surfaces

question: Should the July 21, 2026 release remove compatibility records whose stated removal window runs through July 30, 2026, and if so what supported upgrade path is promised to existing external plugin users?
rationale: The PR describes an early removal sweep but does not link a maintainer decision that supersedes the stated date, and this choice changes the externally supported plugin and configuration contract.

options.title: Honor the published July 30 window
options.body: Keep the affected public paths until after July 30, 2026, while landing only internal-call-site migrations and non-public cleanup now.

options.title: Approve an earlier removal cutoff
options.body: Document the explicit early-cutoff decision and provide upgrade proof for legacy plugin imports and legacy provider credential configuration before merging.

options.title: Split the sweep
options.body: Land unambiguously private removals separately and defer public SDK/config removals to a date-aligned follow-up.

recommendation.title: Honor the published July 30 window
recommendation.body: Keep the affected public paths until after July 30, 2026, while landing only internal-call-site migrations and non-public cleanup now.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author assembled the compatibility registry sweep and is the best available routing point for the claimed early-removal approval and upgrade contract.
